text: Movement of trailer and semi-trailer vehicles is prohibited on the Nakerala Pass and on the Sachkhere (Sareki)–Uzunta–Shkmeri–Zudali road.

Due to snowfall, the movement of trailer and semi-trailer vehicles is temporarily prohibited on the Kutaisi (Motsameta)-Tkibuli-Ambrolauri road of domestic importance, km39-km60 (Nakerala Pass) section, and on the Sachkhere (Sareki)-Uzunta-Shkmeri-Zudali road.
The information is disseminated by the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia. According to them, the movement of all other types of motor vehicles is free.
